Thanks for reporting this. We know about a sync bug in the current app that can leave a Breeze air purifier off or hidden from the device list. Version 4.13.0, rolling out now, fixes it. In the meantime: sign out of the app, force close it, sign back in, and pull down on the device list to refresh. That re-syncs the Breeze air purifier for most people. If it is offline, try running it again later.

Yes, you can return the Sentry doorbell within 45 days of delivery, whether it is open or closed, for a full refund. Go to Orders in your account, pick the Sentry doorbell order, and tap Start a return. You'll get a prepaid label to print or show at any drop-off point. Your refund depays the cost of the return shipping. If the Sentry doorbell has already been set up, please remove it first so we can send it back.
